_source: Transcribed from the in-store Marathon Burger menu board (content/brand/menu-photo.jpg). 'veg' marks the leaf icon items. Combo list confirmed against @themarathonclothing's Nov 2024 combo menu post. Missing descriptions filled from public listings and reviews (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Yelp, California Eating).

items.name: Marathon Burger
items.desc: Two wagyu beef patties smashed with grilled onions, served on a toasted brioche bun and topped with gourmet Fresno peppers, house made pickles, American cheese, ketchup, mustard and our secret sauce.

items.name: Smash Burger
items.desc: Two wagyu beef patties smashed with grilled onions, served on a toasted brioche bun and topped with house made pickles, American cheese, ketchup and mustard.

items.name: OG Burger
items.desc: Two wagyu beef patties smashed with grilled onions, served on a toasted brioche bun and topped with house made pickles, red onions, American cheese, ketchup, mustard, romaine lettuce, sliced tomatoes and our secret sauce.

items.name: Portobello Mushroom Burger
items.desc: Marinated and grilled Portobello mushroom served on a toasted vegan brioche bun and topped with gourmet Fresno peppers, romaine lettuce, house made pickles, garlic lemon aioli, red onions and sliced tomatoes.

items.name: Vegan Burger
items.desc: Vegan patty made with wild rice and potatoes, served on a toasted brioche bun and topped with house made pickles, lettuce, tomatoes, gourmet Fresno peppers and red onions.

items.name: Chicken Sandwich
items.desc: Grilled or fried chicken served with mayo, house made pickles, Fresno peppers and secret sauce. Also available dipped in wing sauce: Mild, Honey BBQ, Hot, Atomic Hot and Lemon Pepper.

items.name: Jr Marathon Burger
items.desc: One wagyu beef patty smashed with grilled onions, served on a toasted brioche bun and topped with gourmet Fresno peppers, house made pickles, American cheese, ketchup, mustard and our secret sauce.

items.name: Kid's Meal
items.desc: Jr Smash Burger, small French fries and choice of a drink: apple juice, chocolate milk, Marathon Water or soda.

items.name: Hot Wing Basket

items.name: Chicken Strip Basket

items.name: Tiger Shrimp Basket

items.name: Grilled Vegetable Salad
items.desc: Red and green leaf romaine lettuce, cucumber, Fresno peppers and cherry tomatoes with grilled asparagus, yellow squash, zucchini and corn, topped with our house made sherry vinaigrette. Add grilled/fried chicken ($6) or grilled/fried shrimp ($10).
